global_rules_for_ai: Backward compatibility koru; migration gerekiyorsa veri kaybı olmasın.
Prod guvenligini dev kolayligina tercih et.
Her P adimindan sonra lint+build+test calistir.
Kritik islemlerde (wipe/export) guvenlik onayi olmadan devam etme.
Dosya/klasor isimlerini tutarli ve kucuk parcalara bol.
definition_of_done: Yeni guvenlik akislarina en az 1 birim testi eklendi

tasks.title: Electron bridge token modelini kapat/sertlestir
objective: Mumkunse HTTP yerine IPC challenge-response modeline gec.
acceptance_criteria: Vault data endpoint auth olmadan bos/403
tasks.ai_prompt: Harden Electron sync bridge security in `electron-main.cjs`. Remove token leakage from status endpoint, enforce strict origin validation, block requests with missing origin, and implement extension allowlist checks. Keep existing functionality for legitimate extension flow. Update any renderer/preload integration accordingly. Add tests or minimal verification script and document behavior.

tasks.title: WXT postMessage dogrulama
tasks.ai_prompt: Add strict message authentication for AEGIS postMessage bridge. Require origin validation and one-time nonce/session proof before processing SAVE_VAULT and LOCK_VAULT messages. Reject unsigned or replayed messages. Preserve normal extension sync behavior.

tasks.title: Legacy extension hattini uretimden cikar
objective: Legacy extension build prod pipeline disinda
acceptance_criteria: Prod build artifact icinde legacy bridge yok
Scriptler net: modern WXT tek kaynak
tasks.ai_prompt: Decommission legacy extension build path for production. Keep it dev-only or remove safely. Eliminate wildcard origin usage in legacy content bridge. Ensure package scripts clearly point to supported extension pipeline.

tasks.title: Prod'da demo auto-seed kapat
objective: Demo kayitlar sadece dev modda eklensin
acceptance_criteria: Dev deneyimi opsiyonel flag ile korunur
tasks.ai_prompt: Disable demo credential auto-seeding in production. Keep optional dev-only behavior behind explicit environment flag. Ensure no sample credentials are inserted in prod startup paths.

tasks.title: Encrypted export varsayilani
tasks.ai_prompt: Implement encrypted backup export/import as default. Use Argon2id for key derivation and AES-GCM for payload encryption. Keep plaintext export only as advanced option with explicit risk warning. Add format versioning and migration-safe parser.

tasks.title: Wipe/Reset cift dogrulama
tasks.ai_prompt: Add two-step confirmation UX for destructive wipe/reset actions: typed phrase + final confirmation modal with clear scope summary. Prevent accidental one-click destructive execution.

tasks.title: Kritik aksiyonlarda re-auth
objective: Export, Emergency Kit, PIN degisiminde master password re-auth
acceptance_criteria: Acik oturumda bile kritik aksiyon re-auth ister
tasks.ai_prompt: Introduce master password re-auth gate for high-risk actions: export, emergency kit generation, and secret PIN updates. Keep UX smooth with clear timeout/session rules.

tasks.title: SettingsDrawer moduler refactor
tasks.ai_prompt: Refactor SettingsDrawer into modular subcomponents: SecurityTab, DataTab, SyncTab, AdvancedTab. Preserve behavior and translations, reduce component complexity.

tasks.title: A11y hardening
tasks.ai_prompt: Improve accessibility in forms and dialogs: proper labels, dialog semantics, focus trap, keyboard navigation, and consistent aria-labels for icon-only buttons.
